investment_theses.thesis: Berkshire Hathaway outperforms mega-cap tech through 2026 as Fed pivot de-rates growth but margin compression favors industrials and value.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Berkshire shares outperforming S&P 500 YTD amid 'AI fears' and market 'swoon'
Q3 buyback acceleration (>$10B repurchases) while operating earnings declined—textbook contrarian timing
Buffett positioning for earnings recession (buybacks work best when valuations compress)
investment_theses.counter_view: AI capex cycle far from peak; NVIDIA and hyperscalers sustain 30%+ revenue growth into 2027; Berkshire's insurance float and equity positions tie it to macro slowdown that never materializes.
investment_theses.expression: Long BRK.B / Short QQQ (or long BRK.B, short NVDA equity weighting 3:1) through June 2026; hedge with SPY calls.

investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin appreciates 20–40% into Q4 2026 as Iran escalation, Fed pivot uncertainty, and crypto exchange consolidation (regulatory squeeze removes weak hands) create safe-haven + scarcity premium.
supporting_signals: Trump admin executing Iran 'minor strikes' + U.S. offering $20M bounty for nuclear intel = escalation posture persists
CoinDesk: MEXC ($16B illicit flows sanction), Binance EU exit, Thailand blocks Bitget = exchange liquidity concentration, reduced retail selling pressure
Berkshire buyback frenzy signals macro hedging; BTC vol premium justifiable in geopolitical crisis scenario
investment_theses.counter_view: Anthropic IPO draws institutional capital away from crypto; regulatory crackdown (payment processor sanctions, card breaches like Gnosis Pay) dampens retail adoption; U.S. rate path tightens if inflation resurges.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC spot via Coinbase/Kraken or BTC perps (5–10x leverage capped) through 2026-09-30; trim 50% at $95K–$100K, trail stops on remainder.

investment_theses.thesis: DXY (U.S. Dollar Index) weakens 3–5% through H2 2026 as Trump fiscal expansion and Miller-driven budget flexibility inflate nominal spending while real yields compress.
supporting_signals: Trump administration populism + Miller appointment (known deficit hawk-flip toward spending hawk post-2016) = fiscal blitz expected
Berkshire buybacks + AI capex slowdown = real asset demand shifts; gold and commodity-linked assets outperform as currency debasement expectations rise
Iran escalation risk pushes oil above $85/bbl, stoking inflation expectations that erode real rate support for USD
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed forced to hold rates higher for longer if fiscal expansion reignites inflation; safe-haven demand for USD in geopolitical crisis offsets fiscal concerns; China capital controls and trade war fears support dollar strength.
investment_theses.expression: Short DXY via DBC (commodities ETF) or long GLD (gold) + long MXN/USD or AUDUSD forwards; hedge with long USD puts (3–6 month expiry at 104 strike).

investment_theses.thesis: Anthropic stock corrects >25% from IPO price by 2027-Q2 as enterprise AI adoption metrics disappoint and data center CapEx ROI questions dominate after midterm backlash narrative.
supporting_signals: CNBC reports midterm voters delivered 'stinging rebuke' to data centers and AI industry expansion

Democratic socialists showed 'best polling yet' on anti-corporate agenda; majority of U.S. voters 'don't actually like socialism' yet elected it—reveals anti-corporate sentiment bleeding into mainstream
Anthropic IPO will face heavy insider selling lockup expiries (typical 6–9 months post-listing); zero enterprise revenue proof points yet public
investment_theses.counter_view: Anthropic's Claude model outperforms OpenAI on benchmark evals; enterprise customers (Google Workspace integration, etc.) ramp faster than expected; IPO valuation reflects optionality, not current revenue.
investment_theses.expression: Short ANTHROP (if ticker available) stock or buy puts (9–12 month duration, 30–40% OTM); alternatively, short the AI sector via QQQ calls (overweight NVDA/META exposure) and long XLV (healthcare, defensive).

investment_theses.thesis: Crypto exchange tokens (FTT, OKB, BNB if Binance re-lists) collapse 30–50% through 2026 as regulatory crackdown (MEXC sanctions, Binance EU exit, Thailand blocks Bitget) consolidates liquidity to compliant platforms and reduces fee yield.
supporting_signals: U.S. Treasury sanctions MEXC over $16B illicit flows; Binance forced to exit European countries by year-end
Thailand blocks Bitget acquisition; Gnosis Pay breach (card data, home addresses, linked wallets exposed) accelerates regulatory scrutiny of decentralized finance onramps
CoinDesk: 'Crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story'—fee compression and consolidation narrative dominant

investment_theses.expression: Short BNB, OKB (or synthetics if illiquid) or buy put spreads (6-month expiry); long Coinbase (COIN) stock as compliant alternative capturing regulatory arbitrage.
